parts.html: The K-16 kitchen model combines the elegance of neoclassical design with a distinctive green color palette and practical contemporary furniture solutions.
Its L-shaped configuration, coordinated cabinet fronts, and carefully selected hardware create a refined kitchen interior where traditional character meets everyday functionality.

The green finish introduces a natural sense of warmth and individuality, making the kitchen a distinctive element of the residential interior. This color pairs beautifully with light walls, natural wood, stone textures, and decorative details in warm neutral tones.

Neoclassical styling allows the K-16 model to retain the elegance of traditional kitchen furniture while maintaining a clean, restrained appearance suitable for contemporary apartments and private residences.

The defining feature of the K-16 kitchen is its practical corner layout. With a total linear length of 4.6 meters, the cabinetry is arranged along two adjoining walls, providing an efficient organization of work surfaces, built-in appliances, and storage areas.
Without a separate island, the configuration preserves valuable floor space and allows greater flexibility when planning dining and circulation areas.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts feature a foil-wrapped finish. Their coordinated solid green color creates a cohesive furniture composition and reinforces the understated character of the neoclassical interior.
The chipboard-based countertop provides a practical surface for everyday food preparation, while the main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
A pull-out cargo storage system makes efficient use of cabinet space and provides convenient access to kitchen essentials.

For comfortable everyday operation, the model includes Muller soft-close hinges and Muller telescopic drawer runners with soft-close functionality. These components support smooth cabinet movement and convenient access to stored items.
The K-16 kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included in the standard configuration, while lift mechanisms are not provided.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and contemporary residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-16 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
Cabinet dimensions, work surface arrangements, and the color of the fronts can be adjusted to suit the interior design concept and functional requirements of the space.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-16 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create an elegant neoclassical interior with distinctive green cabinetry and practical everyday functionality.
